govdocs-archive_org-nsia-FrazierWBCaptai: These witness statements — Capt. W. B. Frazier on the Oswald transfer, creator unknown — are a file on Ruby’s shooting. The transfer went fatally wrong. The file belongs to the assassination archive. The item is a fragment of the record.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abisai: This 1913 reference article on Abisai — Abishai, David's lion-hearted nephew. Anthony Maas recounts his wars and loyalty. He saved the king's life more than once. A soldier-saint of the old kingdom. He slew three hundred Philistines with his spear.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-adonai: This 1913 reference article on Adonai — the Hebrew divine name, my Lord. Edward Heinlein traces its reverent use. Jews spoke it where the text wrote YHWH. The name veils the unutterable. Scripture's title of majesty. Its vowels point the holy name in print.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-aggeus-haggai: This 1913 reference article on Aggeus — Haggai, the post-exilic prophet of the second Temple. Francis Gigot weighs his brief book. Consider your ways, he cried to the builders. Four months of prophecy, forever kept. A small book with a great message.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-angelo-mai: This 1913 reference piece on Cardinal Angelo Mai — the great finder of lost books — honors his toil. Paul Lejay wrote it up. His work brought old texts to light. He served the Vatican Library long. Scholars bless his patient art. The hunter of the hidden page.
